name: Hot Crane
description: Safe Build Engineering manufactures HOT Cranes with advanced technology and premium quality raw materials. Available in single and double girder with load capacities from 12 to 50 tonnes, featuring one floor mounted and one structurally mounted rail. Operated by radio control or cable pendant with anti-corrosive finish and minimal maintenance.
features: Lifts medium and heavy goods up to 50 tonnes
One floor mounted and one structurally mounted rail
Available in single and double girder
Radio control or cable connected pendant operation
Trouble free operation with less maintenance
